CQ05.note: Liam avoids peanut and tree nuts; isSubtypeOf lets 'tree nuts' match almond, hazelnut and pine nut.
CQ05.question: Which products are unsafe, or need caution, for Liam (peanut and tree nut allergy)?
CQ05.sparql: SELECT ?product ?status WHERE { { ?product falcon:unsafeFor falcon:cons_liam . BIND("UNSAFE" AS ?status) } UNION { ?product falcon:cautionFor falcon:cons_liam . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?product falcon:unsafeFor falcon:cons_liam } BIND("CAUTION" AS ?status) } }

      cautionFor(prod_dark_chocolate, cons_liam)   [R08: Caution for consumer]
      |-- Consumer(cons_liam)   [asserted fact]
      |-- mustAvoid(cons_liam, alg_tree_nuts)   [asserted fact]
      `-- mayContain(prod_dark_chocolate, alg_tree_nuts)   [T-CH-4: mayContain ∘ isSubtypeOf ⊑ mayContain]
          |-- mayContain(prod_dark_chocolate, alg_hazelnut)   [asserted fact]
          `-- isSubtypeOf(alg_hazelnut, alg_tree_nuts)   [asserted fact]

CQ06.note: Only possible with negation as failure; OWL alone can never conclude that a product is safe.
CQ06.question: Which products can be confirmed safe for Liam, and why are others excluded?
CQ06.sparql: SELECT ?product WHERE { ?product a falcon:Product ; falcon:hasIngredientListStatus "complete" . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?product falcon:unsafeFor falcon:cons_liam } FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?product falcon:cautionFor falcon:cons_liam } FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?product falcon:hasIngredient ?i . ?i falcon:possiblyTriggers ?a . falcon:cons_liam falcon:mustAvoid ?a } }

CQ07.note: * = closed-world class computed by the engine; all others are OWL defined classes.
CQ07.question: How is each product classified automatically?
CQ07.sparql: SELECT ?product ?class WHERE { ?product a falcon:Product . ?product a ?class . ?class rdfs:subClassOf* falcon:Product . FILTER(?class != falcon:Product) }

CQ08.note: 11 product-allergen pairs are treated differently by markets the product is sold in.
CQ08.question: Which allergens must each product declare in the US, Canada and the EU, and where do the markets disagree?
CQ08.sparql: SELECT ?product ?allergen ?market WHERE { { ?product falcon:mustDeclareInUS ?allergen . BIND("US" AS ?market) } UNION { ?product falcon:mustDeclareInCanada ?allergen . BIND("Canada" AS ?market) } UNION { ?product falcon:mustDeclareInEU ?allergen . BIND("EU" AS ?market) } }
